experiment: Real Two-Host Physical LAN Pilot (Host A to Host B)
reason: Execution environment is a single Linux machine. No independent secondary physical host is reachable or authorized for live bare-metal deployment. Automated preflight correctly verified that 192.168.1.10 and 192.168.1.11 are not reachable on the physical network.
durability_boundary_note: A 2-host topology assigns 10 shards to Host A and 10 shards to Host B. Total loss of either physical host causes 10 shard losses, leaving 10 < K=12 surviving shards. RS(20,12) requires >= 3 physical hosts (or 5 hosts) to guarantee data survivability upon losing an entire physical machine.
